صِنَّارٌ , (K,) or ↓ صِنَّارَةٌ , (S, O, M,) or the latter is not allowable, (TA,) The head of a spindle; (S, O, K;) i. e. (S) the crooked, (S,) or slender, (M,) or slender and crooked, (TA,) piece of iron (S, M, TA) that is in the head of the spindle: (M, TA:) or, accord. to Lth, the latter signifies a woman's spindle; and is a foreign word introduced into the Arabic language. (TA.) ＝
-A2- See also صِنَارٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
